scope: Read-only reconciliation of named saved outputs, central registered statistics, active run identities and quoted table numbers. No producer/model reconstruction, raw remeasurement, acquisition, new estimates or new inference.

common.data: Inherited selected EUR/USD recorded-quote events; previously inspected cache; structural support is not vendor completeness.
common.target_identity: J=d*(m_detection-m_pre_onset)/pip; C_h=d*(m_detection+h-m_detection)/pip; I_h=J+C_h; quote marks strictly precede their targets; d learned during onset/detection second.

07m.sample: Inherited available continuation cohorts; complete joint coordinates within each horizon, plus common 60/300 cohort.
07m.timing: Direction and J known at detection; C and I use future endpoint. Endpoint categories are retrospective.
07m.uncertainty: Descriptive exact saved-sample accounting; no uncertainty in this stage.

07n.sample: Same 07m fixed cohorts and event-weighted means.
07n.uncertainty: Provisional pointwise nominal 95% normal Bartlett calendar-score HAC, common lags 20/40; coverage and score-process assumptions unvalidated; no covariance inverse or new hypothesis tests.

07h.sample: 127013 C300 and 127052 C60 selected events, endpoint availability required.
07h.timing: State Q/M/v precedes onset; direction d and aligned A=dQ/cQ are learned at detection. Baseline includes v, M, A, vM, vA, direction and controls; not a strictly prior-only model or chronological forecast.
07h.uncertainty: Pointwise conditional normal intervals and chi-square(2) joint tests; auto/longer lags 7/14,8/16,8/16,10/20 by C300 baseline/curvature then C60 baseline/curvature. Coverage unvalidated; branch weights treated fixed.

07j.sample: Same observations at 5/15/30-second preceding-variation sampling; inherited five-second scaling and baseline 07h retained.
07j.uncertainty: Inherited numeric lags, no reselection; differences between frequency estimates descriptive, not paired difference or equivalence tests.

07k.sample: Nine restrictions: pre, response, both at caps 15/30/60 seconds; equality passes. Different selected samples.
07k.timing: Pre screen spans 301 historical one-second marks; response/both use future endpoint age and cannot be ex-ante predictors. Detection-time alignment remains.
07k.uncertainty: Inherited numerical lags; restricted-score adequacy and coverage unvalidated; no between-sample inference.

07l.sample: Strict detection-bin abs(net)/gross thresholds >1%, >5%, >10%; equality fails; no age/frequency intersection.
07l.timing: Screen known at detection, not before onset; endpoint availability still retrospective.
07l.uncertainty: Inherited numerical lags; no between-sample inference or validation of true/informed direction.

08.sample: Active version 2, same inherited 127013/127052 cohorts; zero additional attrition. Previous failed attempt preserved.
08.timing: H is pre-onset spread minus its prior-300-second boundary spread; all fitted predictors strictly prior. Outcomes J/C/I and initial/post/total spread use detection/future marks. No chronological evaluation.
08.uncertainty: Provisional pointwise normal 95% Bartlett HAC intervals at fixed 20/40 calendar days; coverage unvalidated; no p-values or causal intervention claim.

09b.sample: 133918 later origins,127058 eligible issued,127013 evaluable,45 issued with unavailable C300;6860 explicit abstentions. Four methods share evaluable IDs.
09b.timing: First-alert C300 forecast; strictly prior allowed X only; J translates predicted C to predicted I.59 expanding cutoffs; train origins before cutoff and available target maturity <= cutoff. Idealized zero processing latency. Forecasts saved and hashed before evaluation.
09b.uncertainty: Exploratory chronological raw MSE/RMSE only; no formal forecast p-values, CIs or superiority inference; not untouched holdout.

limitations: Manifest matches verify fidelity to saved artifacts, not correctness of all methods or vendor completeness.
Central-ledger sources bind the immutable pre-09c snapshot; live scientific entries were checked equal. Subsequent review registration may change the live ledger.
No new intervals, p-values, coefficients, MSE estimates or calendar uncertainty are calculated; arithmetic checks and classifications of saved rows only.
Finite-horizon mean I and near-zero/imprecise mean C cannot establish permanence, eventwise recovery or equivalence.
07h/j/k/l alignment equations, 08 strictly prior pooled associations and 09b chronological forecasts answer different questions.
Conditional association and a negative fixed forecast comparison do not identify causal, informational, inventory or structural regimes, or establish that all predictability is absent.
